solution: A relation is a function if each input (x-value) corresponds to exactly one output (y-value). This is known as the vertical line test: if any vertical line intersects the graph at more than one point, the relation is not a function.

Looking at this graph, which shows a step function with distinct horizontal segments, we can see that every vertical line would intersect the graph at most once. Therefore, this graph represents a function.
